Expertise na configuração dos módulos Teamcenter:

Desenvolvimento de Produtos;

Gestão de Especificações e Regulatório

Lista Técnica (BOM) – Preliminar e Final

Cálculo de rendimento de produção

Processos de Pré Produção, Piloto e Primeira Produção

title: Snowflake Data Architect in Mexico or Brazil
description:
Role: Snowflake Data Architect

Location: Remote – Mexico or Brazil

Job Type: 12 Months Contract


Job Description

• Data Architect – Snowflake

• Advance hands-on SQL

Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

• Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: Analista de infraestrutura Junior - Linux
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Responsável por fornecer suporte técnico na configuração, manutenção e monitoramento de servidores, a fim de garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança dos sistemas e recursos de infraestrutura.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Instala servidores físicos ou virtuais, garantindo a configuração adequada dos sistemas operacionais e softwares relacionados;
  • Suporte de serviços de rede essenciais nos servidores, como DHCP, DNS, Controladores de Domínios, servidores de arquivos e impressão, para garantir a conectividade e a disponibilidade dos recursos de rede;
  • Realiza a manutenção regular dos servidores, aplicando atualizações de segurança, patches e correções de bugs para garantir a estabilidade e a segurança dos sistemas.
  • Presta suporte técnico aos usuários, solucionando problemas relacionados aos servidores, respondendo a solicitações de suporte e fornecendo orientações sobre o uso adequado dos recursos disponíveis;
  • Colabora em projetos de infraestrutura de servidores, auxiliando na implementação de novas tecnologias, migrações ou atualizações de servidores;
  • Mantém a documentação atualizada dos servidores, registrando configurações, alterações e procedimentos relevantes para referência futura e garantindo a consistência nas operações;
  • Mantém-se atualizado com as tendências e avanços tecnológicos relacionados à infraestrutura de servidores, buscando oportunidades de melhoria e otimização dos sistemas;
  • Participar das cerimônias ágeis, como reuniões de planejamento, retrospectivas e revisões, compartilhando informações sobre a infraestrutura de servidores e colaborando para a melhoria contínua do squad ágil.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou área relacionada (desejável). ●

Conhecimentos:

  • Windows Server: Configuração e administração de servidores Windows, incluindo Active Directory, DHCP, DNS e funções de servidor.
  • Linux: Conhecimentos básicos de administração de sistemas Linux, gerenciamento de pacotes e comandos do shell.
  • Backup: Familiaridade com estratégias e ferramentas de backup, para garantir a proteção e recuperação de dados.
  • Redes: Compreensão dos conceitos básicos de redes, protocolos (TCP/IP) e configuração de dispositivos de rede.
  • Administração de servidores: Gerenciamento de servidores físicos e virtuais, incluindo instalação e configuração.
  • Virtualização: Conhecimento em tecnologias de virtualização como VMware ou Hyper-V.
  • Armazenamento: Noções sobre armazenamento de dados, RAID e tecnologias de armazenamento em rede (NAS e SAN).
  • Segurança da informação: Conhecimentos básicos de práticas de segurança cibernética e controle de acesso.
  • Monitoramento e resolução de problemas: Utilização de ferramentas de monitoramento para detectar e solucionar problemas de infraestrutura.
  • Automação e scripting: Habilidades básicas de automação usando scripts como PowerShell ou Shell Script.
  • Resolução de problemas: Capacidade de analisar e solucionar questões relacionadas à infraestrutura de TI.
  • Certificações relevantes em infraestrutura de servidores, como Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), Linux Professional Institute Certification (LPIC), entre outras. (desejável)


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Key Account Manager to manage, nurture, and grow existing client relationships with HBX Group. This role is essential in ensuring client satisfaction, driving account performance, and identifying opportunities for incremental growth. You will be responsible for client onboarding, operational optimization, and ongoing engagement, while collaborating cross-functionally to deliver a seamless and impactful customer experience.


Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

  • Maintain and strengthen relationships with assigned key accounts.
  • Conduct regular client meetings, monthly performance reviews, and reporting.
  • Serve as the main point of contact, ensuring timely resolution of issues and alignment with client goals.


Account Activation & Optimization

  • Understand client operations across departments (e.g., tech, pricing, mapping).
  • Support onboarding of new products and services using Salesforce and Salesloft.
  • Monitor account performance and implement optimization strategies for distribution and pricing.


Growth & Retention

  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities based on client needs and market trends.
  • Build rapport across various levels of the client’s organization.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure delivery of client-specific solutions and improvements.


Required Skills

  • Strong relationship-building and account management capabilities.
  • Commercial acumen and consultative selling approach.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and drive decisions.
  • Proactive, customer-focused, and results-oriented.


Required Tech Skills

  • Proficiency in Salesforce, Salesloft, and BI tools (e.g., Tableau).
  • Strong command of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Basic understanding of API functionality and travel tech platforms.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years in account management, sales, or client services.
  • Fluent in English and source market language (essential).
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% for client visits and meetings.
  • Experience in matrixed organizations and tech-enabled environments.
  • Background in travel, financial services, or related industries is a plus.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.

title: L3 Support Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Support Engineer (Linux / Kubernetes / OpenShift / OpenStack)

Location: Remote


Job Summary:

Looking for an L3 Support Engineer with strong expertise in Linux and hands-on experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack . This role focuses on advanced troubleshooting, system stability, and supporting critical infrastructure in a fast-paced production environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide L3 production support for Linux-based systems and cloud/container platforms.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack environments.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent fixes for recurring incidents.
  • Monitor system performance, availability, and reliability, ensuring minimal downtime .
  • Collaborate with L1/L2 support, DevOps, and engineering teams for issue resolution and improvements.
  • Support incident management, problem management, and change management processes.
  • Work on patching, upgrades, and system maintenance activities.
  • Automate repetitive tasks using shell scripting or other tools .
  • Maintain documentation for issues, solutions, and system configurations .

Required Skills:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Linux (mandatory) .
  • Experience with Kubernetes (deployment, troubleshooting, cluster management).
  • Working knowledge of OpenShift and OpenStack platforms.
  • Experience in production support (L3 level) with incident handling.
  • Good understanding of networking, storage, and system performance tuning .
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools and log analysis .
  • Scripting experience (Bash/Shell/Python is a plus).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP) .
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices .
  • Certifications in Linux, Kubernetes, or OpenStack are a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Ability to work under pressure in critical production environments .
  • Good communication and collaboration skills.

title: Event Operations Specialist
description:
About the job


Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.


Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.


Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.



Who we are


We’re a real Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.


Through our years, we’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from the ground up—with our own team.


Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.



The Opportunity


The Event Operations Specialist provides hands-on support in the planning and delivery of ecoPortal’s sponsored and community events. Working closely with the Events Manager, Events Operations Specialist, Events Co-ordinator, and the wider Marketing team, this role helps ensure events are well-organised, engaging, and run smoothly from start to finish.


By seamlessly overseeing all aspects of event coordination—from initial planning through to post-event analysis—this specialist will play a pivotal role in solidifying and expanding ecoPortal’s influence and engagement globally.


This is a mid- senior role and would suit someone who is passionate about events, is unflappable in the face of multiple competing priorities, has the willingness to jump in and take charge of a large portfolio of events with a cool, calm head.



Key responsibilities


Event Management

  • Plan and execute successful sponsored events in NZ, AU and UK/EU. Full end-to-end management including but not limited to trade shows, conferences, lunches/dinner, awards.
  • Event management includes third party liaison, run pre-event briefings, manage swag, budgeting, logistics, and post-event analysis.
  • Execute full event debriefs at the conclusion of each event, and disseminate thai information to appropriate stakeholders for consideration. And, make recommendations for improvements and future attendance.
  • Collaborate with the Sales team for pre and event follow up and communications.
  • Work closely with the content and creative teams on all event related comms, branding, promotion, collateral and associated marketing.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (sales, customer success, marketing, and product) to ensure events align with overall business objectives and provide value to attendees.
  • Evaluate the success of events and report on key metrics, including attendance, lead generation, pipeline contribution, and ROI.


Community Engagement and Activation

  • Alongside the Head of Events, research the best H&S events in our target regions and recommend future events.
  • Lead ecoPortal's involvement in health and safety networks, infiltrating key communities, where applicable, attending industry gatherings, and establishing partnerships to strengthen ecoPortal’s reputation and presence.
  • Seek out bespoke opportunities for ecoPortal to participate in local, intimate, and partner industry events to increase brand awareness.
  • Develop and manage relationships with our prospects, customers and those in the Health and Safety industry and build a sense of community within ecoPortal’s customer base.
  • Develop and manage relationships with industry influencers, thought leaders, event organisers, and industry professional organisations.



Qualifications & Experience

  • A willingness and a passion to jump in and enjoy the sometimes hectic and unpredictable nature of events!
  • A Bachelor's degree in a suitable field (this may include, but is not limited to these majors) - Business, Marketing/Events, Management, Communications.
  • A minimum of 3 years experience in business events design and execution
  • Very strong organisational skills, you will be dealign with multiple events at any one time and this means you'll need to be an admin wizard.
  • Excellent attention to detail. Managing events across such a busy event calendar means honing in on details, and ensuring all your ducks are in line to ensure smooth execution.
  • Clear and confident communication skills, both written and verbal. With lots of balls in the air it's important that you know how to stay cool and calm, and focused on the task at hand.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment.
  • A proactive, can-do attitude with a willingness to take initiative. This is a senior role - and the expectation is that you'll be able to take ownership of a certain portion of events + mentor and guide others in the team who are more junior.
  • Team player with strong interpersonal skills and a customer-first approach.
  • Previous experience in events, customer service, or marketing is an advantage.
  • Comfortable using Google Workspace (Sheets and docs, and familiarity with marketing tools like Trello and Hubspot a bonus).



Perks & Benefits:

We hope that you're excited by the possibilities that come with working at ecoPortal! In addition to our welcoming and diverse culture, we also offer these fun perks and benefits.


37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.


End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.


❤️

title: Data Engineer Revenue Management
description:
Data Engineer Revenue Management Remote (send your resume in English)


A Iron Mountain está em busca de um Data Engineer Revenue Management motivado(a) e com fluência/nível avançado no idioma inglês para se juntar à nossa equipe de Global Revenue Management (Gestão de Receita Global).

Neste cargo, você será responsável por projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis para garantir dados limpos e acessíveis, transformando dados brutos em insights que impulsionam a melhor segmentação de clientes.

Você fará parte de uma equipe de alto impacto dedicada a direcionar a estratégia de preços global para atingir nossas metas de receita e lucro, exigindo coordenação entre as regiões da América do Norte, Europa e América Latina.


O Que Você Fará

  • Desenvolver Arquiteturas de Dados Escaláveis: Projetar e manter pipelines de Extraction, Transformation, and Loading (Extração, Transformação e Carregamento - ETL) integrando dados de sistemas operacionais globais usando tecnologias Amazon Web Services (AWS) e Structured Query Language (SQL).
  • Otimizar Processos e Automação: Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos internos, redesenhando a infraestrutura para maior escalabilidade e automatizando processos manuais para fornecer conjuntos de dados selecionados para análises e painéis operacionais.
  • Garantir a Excelência Operacional e Governança: Monitorar o desempenho e a qualidade dos pipelines, implementando testes automatizados e padrões de governança de dados alinhados às políticas de segurança da informação da empresa.


O candidato ideal terá:

  • fluência/nível avançado no idioma inglês
  • 3 a 5 anos ou mais de experiência em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines em ambientes corporativos de grande escala.
  • Sólido conhecimento técnico em modelagem de dados, Structured Query Language (SQL) e proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python ou Scala.
  • Capacidade comprovada em processamento de dados distribuídos (ex: Spark) e no uso de plataformas em nuvem para extração e carregamento de conjuntos de dados complexos.
  • Bacharelado ou Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada.


O Que Oferecemos (Benefícios)

  • Localização: Opções de trabalho remoto ou híbrido para apoiar o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.
  • Equilíbrio e Bem-Estar: Programa de férias e dias de folga remunerados.
  • Segurança e Futuro: Planos abrangentes de saúde, bem-estar e previdência privada.
  • Desenvolvimento Contínuo: Oportunidades de aprendizado constante e crescimento profissional em uma organização líder global.


Pronto para ajudar a proteger e desbloquear o valor da informação? Candidate-se hoje mesmo para integrar nossa equipe de Global Revenue Management e construir as bases de dados do futuro!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas. .
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um/uma Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Java Sênior para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por implementar e orquestrar microsserviços modernos, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (Kafka/RabbitMQ) assumindo entregas de ponta a ponta, da implementação ao deploy em produção. Esperamos que você encabece integrações complexas, atue no tuning avançado das aplicações e suas integrações com bancos de dados (SQL/NoSQL) e seja protagonista na adoção de tecnologias emergentes, além de criar ambientes de confiança para revisões de código de alto padrão.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Implementar e evoluir arquiteturas de aplicações de microsserviços e sistemas orientados a eventos, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência e manutenibilidade ao longo do tempo;
  • Elaborar templates de arquitetura de aplicação de referência para o time, sempre que demandado;
  • Protagonizar decisões técnicas com visão de impacto, explicitando trade-offs para o time e para produto, mesmo em cenários com informações incompletas;
  • Garantir a estabilidade dos sistemas em produção, realizando a resposta a incidentes, definindo prioridades de correção e propondo melhorias estruturais para evitar recorrência;
  • Implementar e disseminar práticas de observabilidade (OpenTelemetry, APM com Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído para aumentar a previsibilidade operacional;
  • Conduzir code reviews de alto padrão, orientando o time em boas práticas de arquitetura, design patterns, testes e segurança;
  • Atuar em integrações complexas com sistemas internos e externos, aplicando padrões de resiliência como Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA;
  • Identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria em queries SQL, estratégias de cache e configurações de pool de conexões para otimizar a performance das aplicações;
  • Apoiar diretamente líderes técnicos (Tech Leads) em acordos técnicos entre squad, produto e demais áreas, traduzindo complexidade técnica em impacto de negócio de forma clara e rastreável;
  • Explorar e adotar tecnologias emergentes de forma responsável, avaliando custo, benefício e risco antes da incorporação no stack do time.
  • Aprimorar continuamente os processos e práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando técnicas de uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software, de forma avançada e responsável.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Profundidade em Java avançado: Multithread, gerenciamento de memória/GC, Virtual Threads (Java 21) e domínio das diferenças entre versões LTS, bem como domínio total de programação funcional;
  • Domínio amplo de Design Patterns com capacidade de reconhecer o momento certo de aplicá-los; entendimento de como a Injeção de Dependência funciona internamente (Reflection/Proxies);
  • Experiência sólida com Spring (Boot, Data, Security) e uso de frameworks reativos;
  • Domínio de estratégias de resiliência em integrações: Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA (ex: Resilience4j); domínio do conceito de Idempotência;
  • Experiência prática e profunda com Kafka (Partições, Offsets, Consumer Groups) e RabbitMQ avançado (DLQ, Retry Policies, Exchanges);
  • Capacidade de realizar tuning de queries SQL, criação de índices, e estratégias de cache (local vs distribuído, TTL e invalidação);
  • Domínio avançado de pelo menos um banco de dados relacional e um banco NoSQL (MongoDB ou DynamoDB);
  • Domínio de observabilidade avançada com OpenTelemetry, pelo menos uma ferramenta de APM (Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído;
  • Experiência prática com Kubernetes. Não irá administrar diretamente, mas é necessária experiência de interpretação do ecossistema;
  • Experiência prática com componentes de pelo menos uma Cloud (AWS ou GCP)
  • Capacidade real e experiência em Documentação como código usando Mermaid ou PlantUML através de arquivos markdown;
  • Domínio sólido de estratégias em pelo menos uma ferramenta de IA assistida (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity ou Claude Code), bem como experiência prática de consumo de pelo menos 1 tipo de MCP Server através destas ferramentas.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Ser committer ativo em repositórios open-source relevantes;
  • Experiência em tuning avançado de integração com bancos de dados usando JPA e pool de conexões (ex: HikariCP);
  • Ter realizado publicações técnicas em canais relevantes (blog, artigos, palestras, conferências);
  • Experiência com frameworks como Apache Camel ou outros de integração de sistemas (ESB/EDA);
  • Experiência em arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) de alta complexidade;
  • Conhecimento ou experiência com bancos de dados colunares ou baseados em grafos;
  • Certificações Cloud (AWS ou GCP) ativas;
  • Implementação de API Gateways (Kong, Sensedia, AWS API Gateway) via configuração e/ou código;
  • Experiência em integração arquitetural de APIs de LLM (LangChain, RAG/bancos vetoriais) ou criação de soluções próprias baseadas em IA;
  • Capacidade de liderar migrações de monolitos para microsserviços;
  • Ter implementado mais de dois exemplos de servidores MCP de alta complexidade técnica.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Python Developer
description:

  • Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade com crawling distribuído em escala.

  • Orquestração de containers (Docker e docker-compose);
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git;
  • Conhecimento de cloud AWS.
  • Boa habilidade de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico;

  • Prática em Domain-Driven Design (DDD) e Clean Architecture;
  • Conhecimento de Redes de computadores;

title: L3 Support Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Support Engineer (Linux / Kubernetes / OpenShift / OpenStack)

Location: Remote


Job Summary:

Looking for an L3 Support Engineer with strong expertise in Linux and hands-on experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack . This role focuses on advanced troubleshooting, system stability, and supporting critical infrastructure in a fast-paced production environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide L3 production support for Linux-based systems and cloud/container platforms.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack environments.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent fixes for recurring incidents.
  • Monitor system performance, availability, and reliability, ensuring minimal downtime .
  • Collaborate with L1/L2 support, DevOps, and engineering teams for issue resolution and improvements.
  • Support incident management, problem management, and change management processes.
  • Work on patching, upgrades, and system maintenance activities.
  • Automate repetitive tasks using shell scripting or other tools .
  • Maintain documentation for issues, solutions, and system configurations .

Required Skills:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Linux (mandatory) .
  • Experience with Kubernetes (deployment, troubleshooting, cluster management).
  • Working knowledge of OpenShift and OpenStack platforms.
  • Experience in production support (L3 level) with incident handling.
  • Good understanding of networking, storage, and system performance tuning .
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools and log analysis .
  • Scripting experience (Bash/Shell/Python is a plus).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP) .
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices .
  • Certifications in Linux, Kubernetes, or OpenStack are a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Ability to work under pressure in critical production environments .
  • Good communication and collaboration skills.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Key Account Manager to manage, nurture, and grow existing client relationships with HBX Group. This role is essential in ensuring client satisfaction, driving account performance, and identifying opportunities for incremental growth. You will be responsible for client onboarding, operational optimization, and ongoing engagement, while collaborating cross-functionally to deliver a seamless and impactful customer experience.


Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

  • Maintain and strengthen relationships with assigned key accounts.
  • Conduct regular client meetings, monthly performance reviews, and reporting.
  • Serve as the main point of contact, ensuring timely resolution of issues and alignment with client goals.


Account Activation & Optimization

  • Understand client operations across departments (e.g., tech, pricing, mapping).
  • Support onboarding of new products and services using Salesforce and Salesloft.
  • Monitor account performance and implement optimization strategies for distribution and pricing.


Growth & Retention

  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities based on client needs and market trends.
  • Build rapport across various levels of the client’s organization.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure delivery of client-specific solutions and improvements.


Required Skills

  • Strong relationship-building and account management capabilities.
  • Commercial acumen and consultative selling approach.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Proficiency in Salesforce, Salesloft, and BI tools (e.g., Tableau).

Qualifications & Experience

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Analista de infraestrutura Junior - Linux
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Responsável por fornecer suporte técnico na configuração, manutenção e monitoramento de servidores, a fim de garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança dos sistemas e recursos de infraestrutura.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Instala servidores físicos ou virtuais, garantindo a configuração adequada dos sistemas operacionais e softwares relacionados;
  • Suporte de serviços de rede essenciais nos servidores, como DHCP, DNS, Controladores de Domínios, servidores de arquivos e impressão, para garantir a conectividade e a disponibilidade dos recursos de rede;
  • Realiza a manutenção regular dos servidores, aplicando atualizações de segurança, patches e correções de bugs para garantir a estabilidade e a segurança dos sistemas.
  • Presta suporte técnico aos usuários, solucionando problemas relacionados aos servidores, respondendo a solicitações de suporte e fornecendo orientações sobre o uso adequado dos recursos disponíveis;
  • Colabora em projetos de infraestrutura de servidores, auxiliando na implementação de novas tecnologias, migrações ou atualizações de servidores;
  • Mantém a documentação atualizada dos servidores, registrando configurações, alterações e procedimentos relevantes para referência futura e garantindo a consistência nas operações;
  • Mantém-se atualizado com as tendências e avanços tecnológicos relacionados à infraestrutura de servidores, buscando oportunidades de melhoria e otimização dos sistemas;
  • Participar das cerimônias ágeis, como reuniões de planejamento, retrospectivas e revisões, compartilhando informações sobre a infraestrutura de servidores e colaborando para a melhoria contínua do squad ágil.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Blockchain Payments Coordinator
description:
InvesTec UAE is a forward-looking technology company operating at the intersection of fintech and blockchain innovation. We are focused on building efficient, scalable financial infrastructure powered by digital assets, enabling seamless global payments through blockchain technology.


As we expand our operations, we are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Blockchain Payments Coordinator to support and optimize our crypto payment processes. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the core of digital asset operations and contribute to the evolution of next-generation financial systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily blockchain payment operations, including transaction processing, monitoring, and tracking.
  • Assist in managing crypto wallets, ensuring accuracy in transfers and balances.
  • Support reconciliation of transactions across wallets, exchanges, and internal systems.
  • Monitor payment flows and identify discrepancies or operational issues.
  • Collaborate with operations, compliance, and finance teams to ensure smooth and compliant processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of transactions and prepare operational reports.
  • Assist in managing relationships with payment providers, exchanges, and blockchain partners.
  • Stay updated on blockchain trends, tools, and best practices to improve operational efficiency.


Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in crypto, blockchain operations, fintech, or payments coordination.
  • Basic understanding of blockchain networks, wallets, and cryptocurrency transactions.
  • Familiarity with stablecoins (e.g., USDT, USDC) and crypto exchanges is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Good communication skills in English; Portuguese is a plus.
  • Self-motivated and able to work effectively in a remote, fast-paced environment.


What We Offer

  • Competitive annual salary: BRL 180,000–220,000
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours across Brazil
  • Opportunity to gain hands-on experience in blockchain payments and digital asset operations
  • Exposure to cutting-edge fintech and Web3 technologies
  • Supportive and collaborative international team environment
  • Professional growth and learning opportunities in a rapidly evolving industry
  • Performance-based bonuses linked to operational accuracy and efficiency

title: Data Scientist
description:
Progress Rail’s data science team is looking for a motivated and talented Data Scientist who will primarily focus on developing Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence based data models for condition-based monitoring of its assets. In this role, the candidate will contribute to the design, development and deployment of world class rail products and services vital to our customer’s needs.

The ideal candidate is an experienced self-starter, strong attention to details, with excellent written and verbal skills. Enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced, environment and is willing to take on roles outside of comfort zone. Technical aptitude and being well versed in Data Science tools and processes is a must. The role will work closely with the different engineering teams.


About us:

As a Caterpillar company, Progress Rail is one of the largest integrated diversified providers of locomotive, freight car and infrastructure solutions and technologies for the global rail industry. Our team's deep industry expertise ensures a commitment to quality through innovative solutions.


Key Job Elements

  • Contribute to the design, development, testing, and deployment of software systems and applications.
  • Processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis.
  • Apply Machine Learning and other advanced analytical techniques to develop models for condition-based monitoring of locomotive systems.
  • Apply Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) to support text mining, document summarization and others.
  • Understand the business needs and develop data-based solutions.
  • Doing ad-hoc analysis and presenting results in a clear manner.
  • Supporting field reported issue resolution through data analysis.
  • System integration of Machine Learning models.


Education Requirements


  • B.S, M.S, or PhD degree in quantitative discipline such as data science, data analytics, computer science, engineering, statistics, mathematics, or other related degree.


Technical Skill

• Proficiency in Python, SQL, and relational database systems.

• Hands-on experience across the entire data science project lifecycle , including data acquisition, data cleaning, data engineering, feature scaling, feature engineering, model testing, validation, and data visualization.

• Practical application of machine learning algorithms, such as regression models, XGBoost, neural networks, and others.

• Development of LLM‑based solutions for document search and summarization using RAG architecture.

• Strong applied statistics skills , including distributions, statistical tests, regression techniques, and related analyses.

• Experience with AWS cloud services , including container services, S3, and additional relevant components.

• Advanced data visualization capabilities , using tools such as Power BI and Python Matplotlib to build clear, interactive, and actionable dashboards and reports.

• Strong business acumen , with the ability to communicate data-driven insights effectively to both technical and non‑technical audiences.


Desirable:

• Expertise in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and text mining.

• Work experience in an operations control center or in railway operations planning.


Language:

Advanced English. Direct interface with global teams.


Soft Skills:

  • Compatibility with Our Values in Action (Caterpillar Code of Conduct);
  • Autonomy : Being able to manage yourself, deal with a large number of tasks and solve minor problems proactively and responsibly.
  • Creativity : Proposing innovative and original solutions in order to add value to processes and increase the company's competitiveness.
  • Communication : Can clearly express ideas, thoughts and concepts in order to influence others or gain support.
  • Analytical Ability: The ability to analyze data and information, regardless of their the relationship between them, to enable logical decision-making, based on data.


Additional Information:

The selection process will be carried out through CV analysis, interviews, a technical test and professional profile mapping (DISC).

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description:
Gemini Group (csigemini.com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.com


The Role

The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.


In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.


As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.


Key Outcomes

  • Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
  • Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs.
  • Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
  • Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
  • Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
  • Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.
  • Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit.
  • Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.


Relevant Experience & Competencies

  • At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector.
  • Experience in outbound deal origination planning.
  • Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities.
  • Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development.
  • Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.


Other Requirements

  • Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal.
  • Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required.
  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Analista de Tesouraria Jr (Crédito e Cobrança)
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:


  • Avaliar, com suporte e orientação, crédito para novos clientes, através do levantamento e análise de documentações, referências comerciais e informações financeiras dos clientes (ex. balanço patrimonial, DRE e fluxo de caixa), visando assegurar uma avaliação consistente e evitar inadimplência.
  • Realizar a classificação de risco de crédito (rating), validar com seu superior imediato, recomendar limites de crédito e encaminhar para análise da seguradora.
  • Analisar limites de crédito definido pela seguradora e inserir a validação de liberação de crédito no cadastro dos clientes.
  • Emitir Relatório de Rating dos clientes.
  • Realizar o processo para revisão de limite de crédito para os clientes e validar junto ao seu superior imediato.
  • Acompanhar e analisar status de ordens bloqueadas para faturamento, a fim de identificar e avaliar as informações que estejam impactando na liberação, bem como atuar nas ações necessárias para desbloqueio.
  • Realizar o processo de cobrança junto a clientes inadimplentes, negociando a regularização dos títulos em aberto.


Requisitos:

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e sistemas de análise de crédito (ex.: relatórios Serasa, balanço financeiro) que permite avaliar e analisar riscos de crédito;
  • Conhecimento das técnicas de cobrança, técnicas de negociação e em matemática financeira (ex.: cálculos de juros/encargos, projeções de crédito e caixa);
  • Vivência em Pacote Office, principalmente Excel;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana-BA, para vaga temporária(licença maternidade);
  • Diferencial: experiência com o sistema SAP.


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.


Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.


Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Search Engine Optimization Manager
description:
About us:

At Near, we help top talent in Latin America find remote roles with US companies. Our mission is to create better lives by fostering a remote work culture that transcends borders.


Overview:

One of our fast-growing US clients is looking for a versatile SEO marketer with a strong Growth foundation and proven experience running B2B campaigns. In this role, you'll own the search strategy, drive measurable pipeline growth, and support high-impact marketing initiatives across the funnel.


You’ll spend about 60% of your time on SEO (including AI-driven SEO) and 40% on broader growth projects . From improving rankings on Google and LLMs to launching targeted ads on LinkedIn and Google, you’ll be responsible for identifying the biggest opportunities, creating a plan, and executing quickly.


This is a high-agency, high-impact role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments and wants room to grow.


Responsibilities:

  • Own and evolve the SEO strategy to improve rankings, visibility, and conversions across both Google search and large language models.
  • Conduct keyword research, optimize on-page content, lead technical SEO improvements, and run AI-SEO experiments.
  • Report weekly on performance, key insights, and recommended actions.
  • Launch, manage, and optimize B2B campaigns on LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads to drive qualified leads.
  • Write high-converting copy for ads, landing pages, and growth experiments.
  • Support awareness and demand-gen initiatives, including webinar promotion, content refreshes, and campaign execution.
  • Collaborate closely with the Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to execute cross-functional growth projects.


Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in B2B environments.
  • Proven success in SEO, including technical SEO, content optimization, and AI-driven SEO strategies.
  • Hands-on experience managing and optimizing campaigns on LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads .
  • Proficiency with SEO tools such as SEMrush , Ahrefs , or equivalents.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong copywriting ability, especially for ads and landing pages.
  • High ownership mindset, you prioritize effectively, execute independently, and move fast.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Startup experience or comfort operating in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO) and landing page optimization.

Como parte da equipe de Intelligent Automation, você colaborará com times multidisciplinares para entregar automações robustas, seguras, escaláveis e de alta qualidade.

O que buscamos

  • Integrar automações com APIs, bancos de dados, serviços corporativos e soluções de GenAI/ML e IDP.
  • Atuar em projetos de migração de versões, refactoring ou atualizações de arquitetura A360.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos de solução garantindo performance, segurança e compliance.
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento do framework e processos internos de automação.

title: Template Designer Intern
description:
Na Cape.io, não estamos apenas acompanhando o ritmo da indústria publicitária. Estamos acelerando-o.


Somos uma empresa global de tecnologia com a missão de eliminar o atrito entre o criativo e a mídia. A Cape.io é a primeira plataforma de Automação Inteligente de Campanhas a unificar todo o ciclo de vida de uma campanha. Ao integrar IA e conformidade (compliance) automatizada desde a concepção criativa até a ativação, capacitamos marcas a lançar campanhas de alto impacto e dentro das normas com velocidade e inteligência sem precedentes.


Nossa plataforma conta com a confiança das principais agências e anunciantes do mundo para controlar e distribuir conteúdo publicitário em mais de 100 países. Com mais de 230 funcionários em 21 escritórios — de Londres às Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico — estamos mudando fundamentalmente a forma como a publicidade funciona.


O que você fará

Como Estagiário(a) de Template Design, você ajudará a criar e otimizar templates para clientes. Você participará de projetos de onboarding criativo e auxiliará no treinamento de novos clientes que utilizam nossa ferramenta self-service de Template Designer. Além disso, você será um ponto de contato para suporte e dúvidas técnicas sobre a ferramenta.

Durante seu estágio, você aprenderá:


  • Como construir templates dinâmicos para diversos clientes globais.
  • Como guiar novos clientes através do processo de onboarding criativo.
  • Como fornecer treinamento especializado e suporte técnico sobre nossa ferramenta de design.


O que você traz (Perfil desejado)

  • Formação: Você está cursando ensino superior ou se formou recentemente em áreas correlatas (Design, Publicidade, Marketing,, etc.).
  • Experiência em Design: Familiaridade com ferramentas como Photoshop, InDesign, Figma ou softwares similares.
  • Familiarizado com Automação: Você gosta de otimizar processos e torná-los mais eficientes através da tecnologia.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Você gosta de interagir com pessoas, dar treinamentos e solucionar dúvidas de clientes.
  • Idiomas: Português nativo e proficiência em Inglês e Espanhol.
  • Atenção aos detalhes: Você tem um olhar apurado para design e garante que todos os templates tenham acabamento profissional.
  • Vontade de crescer: Mentalidade curiosa e motivação para desenvolver novas habilidades técnicas e de atendimento ao cliente.


Sobre nossa solução de automação criativa

  • O desafio: Gargalos criativos e operações manuais de Ad Ops geram sobrecarga nas equipes e prejudicam a performance das campanhas. O ciclo infinito de revisões impede que as marcas escalem o que realmente funciona.
  • Nossa solução: Construímos uma plataforma all-in-one para produzir, personalizar e lançar anúncios de alta performance em todos os canais — de redes sociais e display a vídeo e DOOH. Unificamos os fluxos de criação e mídia, permitindo que marcas passem de um único criativo mestre para variações ilimitadas em minutos.
  • Seu impacto: Você estará no coração da nossa missão de libertar a criatividade. Você capacitará nossos clientes a superar a concorrência através de ferramentas que transformam dados em anúncios personalizados de alto impacto em escala.


Nosso DNA: Como trabalhamos

Nossos valores são os princípios que guiam nossas decisões e interações todos os dias:

  • Mova-se com inteligência (Move smart): A hesitação mata o ritmo. Combinamos velocidade com inteligência, transformando desafios complexos em soluções automatizadas.
  • Defina o amanhã (Define tomorrow): Não estamos aqui para atender expectativas, mas para redefini-las. Buscamos qualidade, segurança e escala sem precedentes.
  • Melhores juntos (Be better together): O sucesso se multiplica quando compartilhado. Através da colaboração aberta e apoio mútuo, transformamos potencial individual em conquista coletiva.
  • Mude o que é possível (Change what’s possible): A criatividade impulsiona a humanidade. Nossa tecnologia existe para amplificá-la e permitir que ela decole.

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior (Remoto)
description:
Ola!


A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.


Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.


Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


Estamos em busca de um (a) Engenheiro (a) de Software com IA para projetar, desenvolver e evoluir soluções que utilizam Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning, atuando de ponta a ponta, da concepção técnica até a implementação em produção.

Essa pessoa trabalhará em conjunto com times de produto, dados e negócios para transformar desafios reais em soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alto impacto.


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicações de software que incorporem modelos de IA e Machine Learning;
  • Integrar modelos de IA a sistemas existentes, APIs, pipelines de dados e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Colaborar com cientistas de dados e engenheiros de dados na construção, treinamento, versionamento e deploy de modelos;
  • Implementar práticas de MLOps, garantindo automação, monitoramento, rastreabilidade e escalabilidade dos modelos em produção;
  • Desenvolver soluções baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models) como chatbots, sistemas de recomendação, classificação, busca semântica e automação inteligente;
  • Garantir qualidade de código, segurança, performance e boas práticas de engenharia de software;
  • Participar de decisões de arquitetura, revisões técnicas e definição de padrões;
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua das soluções, avaliando métricas de performance dos modelos e do software;
  • Documentar soluções técnicas e compartilhar conhecimento com o time.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Sólida experiência em engenharia de software (backend e/ou full stack);
  • Proficiência em linguagens como Python, Java, Go, JavaScript ou TypeScript;
  • Experiência com frameworks e bibliotecas de IA e Machine Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, LangChain ou Hugging Face);
  • Conhecimento em APIs, microserviços e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;
  • Experiência com cloud computing (Google Cloud ou Azure);
  • Familiaridade com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD.


❇️ Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prática com LLMs, GenAI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e fine-tuning de modelos;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de dados como Databricks, BigQuery ou Spark;
  • Experiência com MLOps (MLflow, Kubeflow ou Vertex AI);
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta escala ou sistemas críticos;
  • Conhecimento em segurança aplicada à IA e governança de dados;
  • Experiência prévia em produtos digitais orientados a dados.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Colaboração;
  • Visão de dono;
  • Foco no cliente;
  • Pensamento analítico e capacidade de resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas;
  • Comunicação clara e colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade técnica;
  • Curiosidade e atualização constante sobre novas tecnologias de IA.

title: Translator and Project Coordinator
description:
Translator & Project Coordinator


LegalSight is an international legal services and technology company. We are currently hiring for a division of the company which focuses on providing services to law firms across the United States.


We are seeking a bilingual professional to join our Translations Department in a dual-capacity role. The ideal candidate will serve as an in-house Spanish-into-English OR Portuguese-into-English translator, handling daily document translation tasks, while also providing project management support, including covering a Project Manager during periods of absence and independently managing a few translation projects.


This position is well suited to someone who combines strong linguistic precision with organizational skills and a solid understanding of certified translation standards for immigration, legal, and official documentation.


Key Responsibilities:

-Translation (Primary Function)

  • Translate Spanish-language OR Portuguese-language documents into English on a daily basis, including birth certificates, marriage certificates, diplomas, academic transcripts, identification documents, legal contracts, and immigration records.
  • Maintain accuracy, consistency, and appropriate register across all document types.
  • Apply quality assurance procedures, including self-review and adherence to departmental style guides.
  • Assist with post-editing machine-translated content (MTPE) when applicable.


-Project Coordination (Secondary Function)

  • Act as the primary point of contact for project management duties when a Project Manager is out of office.
  • Manage translation projects from intake to delivery, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are met.
  • Coordinate with translators, reviewers, and external vendors; assign tasks and track progress.
  • Monitor project timelines, communicate status updates to clients, and flag potential delays proactively.


Requirements:

-Education & Language

  • Bachelor's degree in Translation, Linguistics, Spanish OR Portuguese, or a related field (required).
  • Near-native or native proficiency in Spanish OR Portuguese (required); native or near-native English proficiency (required).
  • Demonstrated ability to produce accurate, fluent certified translations for official use.


-Experience

  • Minimum 2 years of professional translation experience, specifically Spanish-to-English OR Portuguese-to-English.


-Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to translation accuracy.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills; ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication in English.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and PDF tools (e.g., Adobe Acrobat).


What We Offer:

  • A structured, professional environment within an established certified translation company.
  • Exposure to a wide variety of document types, languages, and complex translation challenges.
  • A clear dual-track career path combining linguistic expertise and project management.
  • Collaborative team culture with experienced PMs and senior translators.

title: ServiceNow Sourcing & Procurement Operations (SPO) Lead/Architect
description:
Role: ServiceNow Sourcing & Procurement Operations (SPO) Architect/Lead Consultant

Location: Remote – Brazil or Mexico

Job Type: 12 Months Contract


Job Description

We are seeking a highly experienced ServiceNow Sourcing and Procurement Operations (SPO) Consultant. In this role, you will act as our internal Subject Matter Expert (SME) and architectural guardian. Your primary goal will be to oversee the design phase, ensure the proposed solutions are architecturally sound and scalable, assist with critical project work, and ensure a seamless knowledge transfer to our internal team upon project completion.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design & Architecture Validation: Act as the client-side Subject Matter Expert (SME) to review, challenge, validate the proposed solution design and architecture, ensuring alignment with ServiceNow best practices and our specific business needs.

• Implementation Oversight & Support: Partner closely with the team to guide the configuration and deployment of the Sourcing and Procurement Operations module.

• Hands-on Configuration: Assist with hands-on system configuration, data mapping, and workflow adjustments as needed to keep the project moving efficiently.

• Process Alignment: Ensure that out-of-the-box (OOTB) ServiceNow capabilities are maximized and custom development is kept to an absolute minimum, aligning technical design with actual procurement (Procure-to-Pay) workflows.

• Knowledge Transfer & Training: Develop and execute a comprehensive knowledge transfer plan. Mentor our internal ServiceNow administrators and procurement stakeholders so they are fully capable of managing and scaling the platform post-go-live.

• Testing & Quality Assurance: Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), helping to define test scenarios and ensuring the final product meets the agreed-upon design specifications.

Required Qualifications:

• Deep ServiceNow SPO Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience designing and implementing the ServiceNow Sourcing and Procurement Operations (SPO) module.

• Procurement Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of broader procurement workflows, including sourcing, purchasing, vendor management, and accounts payable processes.

• Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and conduct effective training.

Preferred Qualifications:

• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Sourcing and Procurement Operations (CIS - SPO).
